findings.detail: CGO_ENABLED=0 does not compile: internal/store's exported types are declared in the cgo file, so the package fails to typecheck rather than merely losing SQLite. Every packaging option inherits this.
goreleaser 2.18.0 builds notriosd and notriosctl for linux/amd64 with CGO_ENABLED=1.
With only the host compiler, 5 of 6 targets fail: runtime/cgo's gcc_arm64.S will not assemble under x86-64 gcc. Only linux/amd64 produced a binary.

With gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu and CC set, linux/arm64 builds a genuine aarch64 ELF and an arm64 .deb. The vendored SQLite amalgamation needed no extra flags. It cannot be executed here (Exec format error), so this is level 2 and not evidence that arm64 works.

lintian: 3 errors (no-copyright-file, no-changelog, extended-description-is-empty) and 297 warnings, including undeclared-elf-prerequisites, hardening-no-pie, no-manual-page, unknown-section, and non-standard-file-perm on every doc file.
The package declares no Depends at all while the binary links libc and libm. nFPM does no shared-library dependency resolution; dh_shlibdeps does.
The control archive holds only control and md5sums. Nothing registers the notrios:// scheme handler or updates the desktop database on install.

Two runs produce different .deb and different binaries. Cause identified: GoReleaser's default ldflags inject -X main.date=<timestamp>, which is recorded in Go build info even though main.date does not exist here. Overriding ldflags fixes it.
goreleaser --clean empties dist/, which this repository already uses for source release ZIPs. One of the two must move.

The package lays out /usr/bin/notriosd with /usr/share/notrios, which is exactly the relationship H5's program-assets resolution derives, so a distro package finds its interface and help with no extra configuration.

makensis 3.09 and the Wails v2.13.0 CLI are installed, so an installer could be generated locally. It would be level 1: a cross-built Windows artifact is not native evidence, and nothing here can execute it.
Nothing about macOS can be established on this machine, and emulating Apple hardware locally is outside this item's boundaries. It needs a native runner.

not_verified: GitHub-hosted runner availability, per-minute cost and artifact retention: not checked against upstream documentation in this pass, so no projection is recorded.
